description:
YH-X9 mountain bike features 6061 aluminum mountain frame and a powerful suspension fork that can reduce the turbulence.19" Aluminum Frame is much lighter than steel.

29er wheels are suitable for the height of more people and make riding more comfortable. The unique 3 Spoke Mag wheels design makes the bicycle more beautiful.

Front and rear mechanical disc brakes make the brake more sensitive and provide crisp stopping and steady speed control on descents.

You can easily change the gears and enjoy the speed excitement with 21 speed shifter.

Recommended rider height: 5'8" ~6'2". This bicycle arrives with 85% assembled. You should install the front wheel, pedals, handlebar, seat and pump up the tires under the guidance of the assembly instructions.

Product description

Eurobike YH-X9 Mountain Bike Aluminum Frame 29 Inch Wheels 21 Speed Shifter Dual Disc Brakes Front Suspension Mens Bicycle

To start a vigorous cycling with YH-X9 lightweight aluminum mountain bike!

Cycling is a nice way to go sightseeing, keep healthy and make friends with new people.

This bike is YH-X9 mountain bike which is equipped with 19 inch lightweight aluminum frame.

Perfect for the TALLER people to go cycling.

The height of the bicycle seat can be adjusted.Our bicycle fits 5'8" ~6'2".

It's YH-X9‘s show time in such a cool season.

Product Advantages

Lightweight Aluminum Frame

19" Aluminum Frame is much lighter than steel. YH-X9 mountain bike features 6061 aluminum mountain frame and a powerful suspension fork that can reduce the turbulence.

Smooth Drivetrain System

YH-X9 adopts Shimano derailleurs (three front gears and seven in the rear)which ensures smooth ride.

Dual Disc Brakes System

Front and rear double disc brakes provide a stable response with reliable stopping action in different kinds of weather to makes the journey safer.

How to assemble this bike?

It needs a few minutes.

This bicycle arrives with 85% assembled. You need to install the front wheel, pedals, handlebar, seat and pump up the tires under the guidance of the assembly instructions.

Bicycle assembly instruction is in the package, please read it more carefully before installing the bike and tuning the brake and speed system.

All tools are included in the package. Seriously following the installation instruction to assemble it，your bike will work well！

If it is possible, we recommend bringing it to a local shop for a safety check/tuning by a bike mechanic to riding and at regular intervals thereafter.
